description: Get an app's privacy information. Android: the Google Play data safety section (data shared with third parties, data collected and why, security practices, privacy policy link) and the Android permissions it requests, grouped by type. iPhone/iPad: Apple's App Privacy labels (data used to track you, data linked to you, data not linked to you) with data categories and purposes.

app_id.description: Android package name (e.g. com.whatsapp) or numeric App Store id (e.g. 310633997).

name: get_app_privacy
title: Get app privacy and permissions
